title: Stellar Home #2 | KEY.co
description_expanded: As you ascend to the upper floors of this newly constructed three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom abode, the allure of mountain views continues to enchant. The residence features two king-size ensuite bedrooms, each a sanctuary of comfort with luxurious bathrooms, and a third bedroom with a queen-size bed, perfect for relaxing after a day on the slopes. Additional living spaces include a mudroom designed for ski storage and a bonus area for entertainment, making it ideal for families or groups seeking a stylish and spacious getaway. Nestled within the vibrant Mountainside Community at Northstar, you are just minutes from the charming shops and gourmet dining of the Village at Northstar and historic Downtown Truckee, placing the best of the region right at your doorstep. Experience the pinnacle of mountain living at this modern ski-in/ski-out Northstar vacation townhome. Positioned directly on the Home Run Trail, this property offers unmatched access to the slopes and is a skier’s dream come true. With exclusive access to community amenities including a heated saline pool, hot tub, and a full sports facility, every day promises new adventures and deluxe relaxation. The home itself is a haven of luxury, from the gas fireplace in the living room to the gourmet kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. Whether you're watching skiers glide by from the comfort of your deck or stepping out to join them, this retreat ensures a seamless blend of excitement and ease.

Features: Outdoor dining Community hot tub Community pool
Parking for four vehicles; driveway parking for two
